script.title: THE GEL MANICURE
script.scene_zh: 美甲店 · 指定顏色與卸甲
script.story_hook: A client picks a gel color and finds the cause.
script.intro_zh: 客人挑好凝膠顏色，也找到了指甲剝落的原因。

script.outro: Color picked, cause found, next visit booked. Hands look happy.
script.outro_zh: 顏色挑好、原因找到、下次也約好，雙手很開心。
script.practice_intro_en: Now, repeat after me, one line at a time.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在請你一句一句跟著我複讀。

Want to chat naturally at a nail salon? This gel manicure conversation covers choosing a champagne shade, reporting chipped polish, finding out why water ruins gel, and booking your next visit. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a listen-and-repeat section for the whole dialogue.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】💅美甲英文｜指定色號・反應剝落・預約卸甲｜聽完就會跟美甲師聊｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
凝膠指甲沒撐過兩週，要用英文怎麼反映？
香檳色、持久款、卸甲，一個詞都卡關？

這一集帶大家走進安靜明亮的美甲店，跟著一位熟客從指定香檳色、反應剝落困擾，到聽美甲師點出洗碗泡水的關鍵，最後當場約好下次卸甲，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
💅 指定顏色：例如「Something champagne-ish, very natural looking.」、「shade twelve is exactly that.」。
🧴 反應剝落：例如「two already peeled」、「Do you wash dishes a lot?」。
📅 持久度與預約：例如「it lasts about three weeks」、「I'll book my next visit now.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次躺在美甲椅上，安心開口慢慢聊！
script.title_quote: Do you wash dishes a lot

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi Linda! I'd like a gel manicure.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ˈlɪndə aɪd laɪk ə dʒəl ˈmænɪˌkjʊr/
dialogue.zh: 嗨 Linda！我想做凝膠美甲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure! Did you have a color in mind?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr dɪd ju hæv ə ˈkʌlər ɪn maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 好啊！你有想好的顏色嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 想要香檳色調，看起來很自然的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, shade twelve is exactly that.
dialogue.zh: 喔，十二號色正是那種感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can you fix these chipped ones first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt kæn ju fɪks ðiz ˈtʃɪpt wʌnz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。能先幫我修已經剝落的這幾根？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. How long have you had them?
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs haʊ lɔŋ hæv ju həd ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 當然。這副指甲你做了多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just nine days, and two already peeled.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst naɪn deɪz ænd tu ɔlˈrɛdi pild/
dialogue.zh: 才九天，就有兩根開始剝了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, that's quick. Do you wash dishes a lot?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðæts kwɪk du ju wɑʃ ˈdɪʃɪz ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那算很快。你常用手洗碗盤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, yeah, and I never wear gloves.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl jɛ ænd aɪ ˈnɛvər wɛr ɡlʌvz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，是啊，而且我都不戴手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's usually the trick, water does it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈjuːʒuəli ðə trɪk ˈwɔtər dʌz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 問題通常就在這裡，是水造成的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I get the longer-lasting kind today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ɡɛt ðə ˈlɔŋər ˈlæsɪŋ kaɪnd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那我今天該選更持久的那種嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It won't hurt, it lasts about three weeks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt woʊnt hɜrt ɪt læsts əˈbaʊt θri wikz/
dialogue.zh: 不會傷指甲，大概能撐三週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, let's try it with champagne.
dialogue.zh: 好，那就用香檳色試試這一款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good pick. Any trouble taking these off?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pɪk ˈɛni ˈtrʌbəl ˈteɪkɪŋ ðiːz ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 好選擇。之前卸甲有遇到什麼問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last time, removal took a whole hour!
dialogue.phonetic: /læst taɪm rɪˈmuːv tʊk ə hoʊl ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 上次卸甲整整花了一個小時！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours takes twenty, and the gel comes off clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊrz teɪks ˈtwɛnti ænd ðə dʒɛl kʌmz ɔf klin/
dialogue.zh: 我們這兒二十分鐘，而且卸得乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, I'll book my next visit now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt aɪl bʊk maɪ nɛkst ˈvɪzɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我當場先把下次預約好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect! Hands in the water, please.
dialogue.zh: 完美！請先把手泡進水裡。
